context: Two friends recall a rival school they played against in middle school
purpose: Teach: 中学校/僕ら/全身/歌い/おしゃべり/笑う/班/ライバル

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なあ、中学校の時さ、サッカーで毎年ぶつかってたライバル校って覚えてる?
lines.en: Hey, remember our rival school we played against every year in middle school?
lines.style: Casual nostalgic tone, slightly drawn out and warm

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もちろん覚えてるよ。あそこの子たち、試合中ずっとおしゃべりしてて生意気だったよね。
lines.en: Of course I remember. Those kids were so cheeky, chatting nonstop during the matches.
lines.style: Soft warm voice with a teasing grin, gentle pace

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうそう、僕らがゴール決めるたびにベンチでなぜか歌い出すんだよ。
lines.en: Yeah, and for some reason they'd start singing on the bench whenever we scored.
lines.style: Laughing under his breath, energetic and amused

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふふ、思い出すと今でも笑うよね。全身泥だらけになって走り回ってさ。
lines.en: Haha, it still makes me laugh thinking about it. We'd be covered head to toe in mud.
lines.style: Light airy laugh, fond and a little wistful

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 応援団も三班に分かれて声出してたっけ。あれ、ちょっと本気すぎたよな。
lines.en: The cheer squad split into three groups too, didn't they? That was almost too intense.
lines.style: Reminiscing, head tilted with a chuckle, mid pace

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本気だったからこそ楽しかったんじゃない?またあのメンバーで集まりたいなあ。
lines.en: It was fun precisely because we took it so seriously. I'd love to get everyone together again.
lines.style: Dreamy and sincere, voice softening at the end

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね、来月あたり同窓会企画しようよ。連絡先、僕がまとめとくから。
lines.en: Sounds great, let's plan a reunion around next month. I'll gather everyone's contacts.
lines.style: Decisive but warm, slightly excited rising tone
